method: Background tests only; no physical desktop input or visible UI tests.

Image sequences preserve their start frame, count and flatten colour

popups.method: Production popup and desktop controllers, real HTML navigation inventory, in-memory DOM and controlled animation promises. No native graphical layout or desktop input.
popups.note: Retained: popup and menu code unchanged in the rebuilt public 1.0 alpha.

checks: Dialog contains only close, file selection, progress/status and the requested action; all five languages present
Startup defaults to MP4 HQ keep size and copies the template when opening

Normal conversion and update activity prevent starting parallel work; Escape exits
simpleMode.method: Production Simple mode controller, probe and queue functions with in-memory DOM; real bundled FFmpeg/FFprobe and temporary videos. No visible UI, physical input or actual browser layout test.
simpleMode.note: Rerun with the changed media preflight and external test conversion programs; UI itself is unchanged.

checks: Rapid slider changes coalesce; pending loads reflect the latest value; close flush bypasses debounce
Windows sharing violations retry asynchronously and never remove the old destination
Permanent lock preserves valid JSON and retains the newest unsaved value for retry
A changed value arriving during a write cannot be overwritten by an older save
Disk errors are not retried as sharing locks and cleanup cannot hide the original failure
Production app-close waits for preferences and stays open after a failed save
settingsPersistence.method: Production preferences and close function; real temporary files with injected Windows sharing errors. No access to OneDrive or user settings.
settingsPersistence.note: Retained; storage/preferences and app-close host code are unchanged.

publicRelease.note: User-requested public label and external conversion tools. UI/game unchanged; host and media preflight now use original-root tools across updates. Local alpha.1/alpha.2 copies require a manual installation.

Closing and reopening while audio starts resumes a live game
Unreadable save never silently starts and overwrites progress
Reset recovers from a stopped game worker
gameRecovery.method: Production game controller and emulator with synthetic startup delays, background visibility events, unreadable save and terminated worker. No native input, sound or windows.

audio.method: Production audio worklet with a virtual device clock; real supplied ROM and production worker. No speakers or native audio device used.

retainedGameChecks.note: ROM/emulator/audio/CRT are unchanged. Historical deterministic ROM/audio checks retained; controller lifecycle and recovery checks rerun for 1.0 alpha 1 after the options-save error handling change.

aurora.method: Production Canvas renderer evaluated offline using @napi-rs/canvas; no app windows, desktop input or audio.
aurora.limitations: Native software Canvas timing is not Chromium/GPU performance or a conversion benchmark. Actual app appearance remains for the user to test.
aurora.note: Historical report: its timing did not force Canvas readback and may omit deferred raster work. Use the current background report for forced-readback software timing. Current checks also verify identical Aurora pixels.

backgrounds.method: Production Canvas renderer evaluated offline using @napi-rs/canvas. No app windows, desktop input, real audio or network.
backgrounds.limitations: Software Canvas timings are not Chromium/GPU measurements or conversion performance. User desktop and Linux rendering remain untested.
backgrounds.note: Historical full-HTML hash. The complete background renderer remains byte-identical in this public 1.0 alpha build; current UI source checks cover that comparison.

uiSyntaxAndScope.method: Source syntax and linked assets; all runtime files except the declared version/host/media-tool changes match alpha.2. Not a graphical layout test.

performance.method: Three alternating paired FFmpeg CPU conversion runs on a generated 48-second 1080p clip; production NES worker and AudioWorklet driven by an in-memory audio device, 30 Hz video presentation and save messages. Excludes Chromium compositing, physical audio and CRT display. Hardware-specific measurement, not a universal guarantee.
performance.note: Retained measurement: game worker, audio worklet and CRT renderer remain unchanged. This does not cover the 2.0.4/2.0.5 backgrounds or native Chromium/GPU rendering.

desktopUI.status: Centered popup styling and real animation appearance require user testing. Background tests cover popup/editor handoff, navigation, interrupted animation, reduced motion and Simple mode conversion with in-memory DOM.
desktopUI.userFeedback: User confirmed game audio/CRT were good and liked the Aurora improvement; requested matching popup style and simpler menus after alpha 1.
desktopUI.reason: The prior hidden Electron renderer test failed with exitCode 49 even for a minimal data page; GPU subprocess failed with 0xC0000135. Sandbox remained enabled. That blocked test was not repeated. No visible window, physical input or audio device was used.

linux.status: packaged only; not run on Linux

rustPopup.status: not reproduced; no Rust compiler or invocation in the application
rustPopup.note: User considers another agent a likely source. Game and media lifecycle diagnostics added to Data/Logs/application.log.
